A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same OccDirector study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E are readable and matchable despite repagination and formatting changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original generation experiments, architectural ablations, dataset validation, and a human evaluation study in Tables 3–5 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the original generation experiments, ablations, dataset validation, and human evaluation results, including Tables 3–5 and S3–S8.

M1.justification: The encoder, token refiner, STSA backbone, flow-matching objective, and history anchoring remain unchanged. Section 3.3 now specifies 2D spatial plus 1D temporal RoPE, matching the implementation already described in v1 Appendix A.1 rather than introducing a new architecture.

E1.justification: Both versions use OccInteract-Static, OccInteract-Env, and OccInteract-Agent, combining UniOcc logs, CarlaSC simulation, and TTSG scenarios. The represented tasks, scenarios, and dataset composition in Table 1 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 3–4 retain DOME, COME, DynamicCity, DynamicCity + CLIP, and DynamicCity + T5. The supplementary encoder comparisons, cross-judge comparisons, and user-study comparator membership also remain unchanged.

E3.justification: The training settings, 10K ground-truth/generated 16-frame evaluation sets, five sampled frames per clip, metrics, and primary Gemini judge are unchanged. The expanded v2 Section 5.1 restates settings already documented in v1 Table S1 and Appendix A.4.

E4.justification: Table 5 and Appendices B–C retain the same attention/refiner ablations, architecture and encoder sensitivity studies, anchoring and CFG analyses, resource-scaling measurements, cross-VLM validation, user study, and qualitative cases.

E5.justification: Both versions report five evaluations per instance for 100 instances per sub-dataset, participant-averaged human scores, and Pearson correlations. Neither adds training-seed information, confidence intervals, significance tests, or a revised uncertainty-estimation practice.

E6.justification: The numerical results and qualitative examples match throughout the main paper and supplement. For example, full OccDirector retains FVD 275 and VLM mean 3.73 in Table 4, and human mean 3.85 with correlation 0.88 in Table S8.

T1.justification: The flow-matching formulation, masked anchoring loss, and supplementary definitions and derivations in Equations S1–S16 are unchanged. The revised main-text RoPE wording restates the existing implementation rather than changing mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The central generation, architecture, and benchmark contributions remain. However, v2's abstract newly describes the dataset as '85k clips'; unchanged Table 1 distinguishes 73.5k single frames from 7.6k environment clips and 4.6k agent clips. This changes the stated dataset contribution without establishing expanded coverage.

C2.justification: The interpretations of temporal coherence, baseline mode collapse, and semantic grounding remain unchanged. Appendix D retains the same limitations concerning sensor artifacts, consistency beyond eight seconds, VLM-judge bias, and semantic granularity.

D1.justification: Appendix E adds explicit public/synthetic-data provenance and declarations about academic resource use and separation from Li Auto production systems. Resource links remain unchanged. Most details added to the main text already existed in v1's appendix; the new claim that listed models serve solely as baselines or annotators conflicts with Qwen's retained encoder role.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and substantive positioning are retained. Inception-v3 and I3D references newly included in the main bibliography were already cited in v1 Appendix A.4, so they do not expand the paper-wide set of cited works.

P1.justification: v2 rewrites the abstract, brings existing supplementary details into Sections 3–5, and makes localized wording corrections. It also updates affiliations, funding acknowledgments, running headers, and Appendix E headings while retaining the overall section structure.

P2.justification: Existing figures are resized or relocated, and main-text tables receive captions above them and revised spacing or sizing. Colored cross-references and continuous appendix pagination update navigation and layout. No figures, tables, or experimental panels are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 improves main-text self-containment and aligns the RoPE description with the existing appendix. However, it introduces conflicting descriptions: '85k clips' versus Table 1's predominantly single-frame dataset, and Appendix E.2's baseline/annotation-only model usage versus Qwen's encoder role. With the scientific evidence unchanged, these clarity gains and new inaccuracies leave the net quality direction uncertain.
